I've corrected the record in GBrain: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47.

- **Old fact:** I withdrew the Dock 23 fact (#1) and noted Pree's correction as the reason. GBrain keeps it in its history, but it's no longer an active fact.
- **New fact:** I saved Gate 47 as fact #2, credited to Pree's correction in #central-team (ts 1791986400.000125). It says it replaces the earlier Dock 23 note.
- **Reply:** I answered Pree in that thread to confirm the update.

When I checked Marrow Agrisupply's facts before the change, Dock 23 was the only one. GBrain can only catch exact duplicates right now, though, so it couldn't look for the same fact saved in other words.
